extracted.intended_audience: senior intelligence-community and federal agency officials responsible for contracting, security, and OMB policy (e.g., DCI, agency heads, contracting officers)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and internal memorandum related to OMB Circular A-76 focusing on contracting/out­sourcing decisions that affect handling of sensitive intelligence, and the administrative routing/format for DCI correspondence on the subject.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request to clarify contracting guidelines for communications, data automation, and security services
rubrics_metrics.description: That you sign the attached letter to the Director, Office of Management and Budget requesting he clarify contracting guidelines for communication, data automation and other security services relating to sensitive intelligence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The attached letter has been prepared to describe DCI concerns about contractor access and to seek OMB clarification; the Action Requested section of the memo should explicitly ask OMB to provide this clarification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limit contractor access to sensitive intelligence / avoid unnecessarily broad contractor access
rubrics_metrics.description: DCI concerns about unnecessarily broad contractor access to sensitive intelligence; agencies should not permit contractor access that could diminish security.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cites the Department of Energy's attempt to contract out communications services for its all-source center as the generic issue prompting action. The letter asks Mr. Stockman to instruct Department and Agency Heads not to contract for services which could diminish security.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not contract services which could diminish security (instruction to OMB to direct agencies)
rubrics_metrics.description: Ask OMB to instruct Department and Agency Heads not to contract for services which could diminish security.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an explicit policy request: OMB should issue instructions to agency heads preventing contracting actions that would reduce the security of sensitive intelligence—i.e., a prescriptive prohibition/restriction on certain outsourcing decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Memorandum structure: include Action Requested, Background, Recommendation
rubrics_metrics.description: DCI memo format presents discrete sections: 1. Action Requested; 2. Background; 3. Recommendation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these labeled sections to make the request clear: Action Requested should state the specific signature/endorsement requested; Background should summarize context and problems (e.g., DOE case); Recommendation should state the recommended official action (e.g., sign the letter). Include distribution list and routing as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Routing/comment form requirements (FORM 61) and comment numbering
rubrics_metrics.description: Routing and receipt sheet instructions: include DATE, OFFICER'S COMMENTS, and number each comment to show from whom received/forwarded. Draw a line across the column after each comment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use FORM 61 and prior editions as appropriate; follow the indicated conventions for tracking comments and routing internal correspondence to preserve provenance and reviewer identity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution and registry notation
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify distribution list (e.g., Orig - Addressee; EXDIR; D/OEA; ER; D/ICS; D/OCC/ICS; IC Registry) in memorandum routing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure recipients and the IC Registry are listed for recordkeeping and traceability; include appropriate distribution codes and copies as shown in the sample memo.
